## Get in touch

For research collaboration, invited talks, teaching exchanges, podcasts, interviews, or questions about my work, email me at [petr.specian@fsv.cuni.cz](mailto:petr.specian@fsv.cuni.cz).

### PPE students and applicants

If your question concerns the Politics, Philosophy and Economics programme, start with the [programme website](https://studyppe.com/), which answers most admissions and study questions faster than I can. Thesis supervision enquiries are welcome by email with a short outline of your question; see [Teaching](teaching.html#supervision).

### Speaking

I speak in English and Czech on AI and democracy, the future of universities, and institutional adaptation to technological change, for academic and general audiences. See [Talks & Media](talks.html) for the track record.
